papers.title: Defect analysis and fatigue design basis for Ni-based superalloy 718 manufactured by selective laser melting

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究镍基高温合金的疲劳缺陷，与生物医学植入物的应力遮挡和多孔结构无关。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure, no biomedical implant context, no stress shielding or stiffness matching, and no osseointegration or surface morphology analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 建立选区激光熔化镍基高温合金的疲劳设计基础。
summary_zh.method: 通过缺陷分析和疲劳实验，研究工艺缺陷对疲劳寿命的影响。
summary_zh.result: 提出了基于缺陷尺寸的疲劳寿命预测模型。
summary_zh.validation: 通过疲劳实验数据验证模型准确性。

summary_en.motivation: To establish a fatigue design basis for Ni-based superalloy 718 fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Defect analysis and fatigue experiments were conducted to correlate process-induced defects with fatigue life.
summary_en.result: A defect-based fatigue life prediction model was proposed and validated.
summary_en.validation: Experimental fatigue data were used to validate the prediction model.

papers.title: Effect of porosity variation strategy on the performance of functionally graded Ti-6Al-4V scaffolds for bone tissue engineering
papers.first_author_affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Tribology, Department of Mechanical Engineering, Tsinghua University, Beijing 100084, China

corresponding_authors.name: Gang Fang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Tribology, Department of Mechanical Engineering, Tsinghua University, Beijing 100084, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了多孔钛合金支架的孔隙率梯度设计对力学性能和骨组织工程应用的影响，与用户关于增材制造生物医用植入物的研究方向高度相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not include fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究孔隙率梯度策略对多孔钛合金支架力学性能和骨整合潜力的影响。
summary_zh.method: 设计并制备了不同孔隙率梯度的Ti-6Al-4V多孔支架，进行力学测试和有限元分析。
summary_zh.result: 梯度孔隙率支架实现了更好的力学性能匹配，降低了应力遮挡效应。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩实验和有限元模拟验证了力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how porosity gradient strategies affect the mechanical performance and osseointegration potential of porous titanium alloy scaffolds for bone tissue engineering.
summary_en.method: Functionally graded Ti-6Al-4V scaffolds with varying porosity gradients were designed, fabricated, and characterized through mechanical testing and finite element analysis.
summary_en.result: Graded porosity scaffolds achieved improved mechanical compatibility and reduced stress shielding compared to uniform porosity designs.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated through compression tests and finite element simulations.

papers.title: Data-driven uncertainty quantification for predictive flow and transport modeling using support vector machines
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Aerospace Engineering and Engineering Mechanics, The University of Texas at Austin, Austin, Texas, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Jiachuan He
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Aerospace Engineering and Engineering Mechanics, The University of Texas at Austin, Austin, Texas, USA

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文将支持向量机用于地下流动与传输模型的不确定性量化，方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的UQ任务。
llm.why_not_core: This paper applies SVM-based UQ to subsurface flow problems, not to FEA surrogate modeling or implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效量化地下流动与传输模型中的参数不确定性
summary_zh.method: 利用支持向量机构建代理模型，结合蒙特卡洛采样进行不确定性传播
summary_zh.result: SVM代理模型在计算效率上优于传统蒙特卡洛方法，且精度可接受
summary_zh.validation: 基于数值基准案例（如PCE和MC对比）验证代理模型精度

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently quantify parametric uncertainty in subsurface flow and transport models using a data-driven surrogate approach.
summary_en.method: Support vector machines are trained as surrogate models to approximate the forward model, enabling Monte Carlo-based uncertainty propagation with reduced computational cost.
summary_en.result: The SVM-based surrogate achieves comparable accuracy to polynomial chaos expansion and Monte Carlo methods while significantly reducing the number of forward model evaluations.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmark problems (e.g., porous media flow) by comparing surrogate predictions against full-physics simulations and reference UQ methods.

papers.title: Uncertainty quantification with hybrid $$\alpha $$ α -cut
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Isfahan University of Technology, Isfahan, 84156-83111, Iran

corresponding_authors.name: Seyed Sadredin Mousavi
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Isfahan University of Technology, Isfahan, 84156-83111, Iran

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及不确定性量化方法，但未与有限元代理模型或生物力学设计结合。
llm.why_not_core: No surrogate modeling, no FEA integration, no biomedical or implant application.

summary_zh.motivation: 提出混合α-cut方法以改进不确定性量化。
summary_zh.method: 结合模糊集与概率方法进行不确定性传播。
summary_zh.result: 方法在理论上提高了不确定性量化的精度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过理论示例验证，无实际应用案例。

summary_en.motivation: To improve uncertainty quantification by proposing a hybrid alpha-cut method.
summary_en.method: Combines fuzzy set theory with probabilistic approaches for uncertainty propagation.
summary_en.result: The method theoretically enhances the accuracy of uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.validation: Validated through theoretical examples without real-world applications.
